title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?

sentence: With autumn in full swing, the West of England is a popular region for tourists to make cosy getaways, with the chocolate box villages of the Cotswolds proving particularly popular.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?

sentence: But, with the post-pandemic rise in visitors in some areas, tensions have risen in villages such as Bibury.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: The village is home to about 600 people but can see up to 20,000 visitors a day, with fences having to be installed to stop tourists paddling in the river.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Twenty-four miles away, in Painswick, Carol Maxwell said that while there are an "awful lot" of tourists in the village, there is a balance with most "really nice and appreciative".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Victoria Summerley, who has lived in Bibury for 14 years, told the BBC last week that the behaviour of some tourists had become worse since Covid, with "unbelievable" amounts of litter ending up in the stream.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Meanwhile, Maxwell said that while Painswick had seen an increase in visitors, they were "not exactly loud and they don't create a bad atmosphere".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: She said she did not think anyone felt that tourists were a "nuisance or an imposition or anything like that" and that they spent money in the village having cups of tea.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "They're not causing problems at all," she added.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Cotswolds Lavender near Snowshill, sees thousands of visitors every summer.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Farm director Hannah Webb said tourists and influencers coming, taking and sharing photographs have driven business, but it can cause problems.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "We're very lucky to have something people want to see and want to tell people that they've been to us," said Webb.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: The field has paths that have been mown between rows of lavender and wildflowers to create the illusion of visitors standing in the flower beds in photographs, but some have been sitting and laying down to get the perfect picture which has led to a lot of "squashed plants".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: A few years ago, they decided to put up signs to warn people to be more careful which Webb said "completely changed" people's behaviour and now they are "so much more respectful".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: She said they took a similar approach to people disobeying their dogs on lead policy, which is in place to protect insects and mammals that nest among the flowers, and that has also led to "more positive results".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?

sentence: In Wiltshire, Castle Combe is among the most popular Cotswolds locations to visit.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: It was the backdrop to films such as Stardust and War Horse, and a bridge which stretches over the River Bybrook is often packed with people taking photos.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Most visitors to Castle Combe "enjoy the village respectfully", said local councillor Jon Atkey.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: However, the village can struggle to cope with the volume of vehicles and people during busy spells.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Atkey said: "Castle Combe's roads and infrastructure were never designed to accommodate the levels of traffic we now see.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "During busy periods, traffic can become heavily congested, with cars circulating in search of parking spaces and spending long periods queuing through the village.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "Residents are understandably concerned about the impact this has on both safety and air quality.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "The vast majority of visitors simply want to enjoy one of England's most beautiful villages, and they should continue to be welcomed.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: "The challenge for all of us is finding a better balance that enables people to visit while ensuring Castle Combe remains a thriving community and a good place for residents to live."

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Dr Amir Gohar, University of West England, has worked on tourism policies in environmentally sensitive areas with rapid tourism development.

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: He said the phrase "overtourism" is when the "tourist get the attention of the government and transforms cities and villages to serve the tourists more than serving the local community or the people".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?

sentence: In areas popular with tourists in the South West, including the Cotswolds, Somerset and Wiltshire, it can mean more pressure on infrastructure like parking, water, sewage and waste collection as high tourist numbers are "not accounted for when planning the town or village".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Dr Gohar said having lots of visitors can also impact "housing affordability" as businesses or development companies start to cater more for the tourists with short stays or Airbnb's which means the "prices get high and the local residents pay that price".

title: Cotswold tourism, is it a blessing or a burden?
author: Maisie Lillywhite
sentence: Finding a balance between visitor experience and the residents wellbeing is a "challenge" that "it needs to be regulated", he said.

title: Irish Travellers' nomadic life 'is at risk', says support committee

title: Irish Travellers' nomadic life 'is at risk', says support committee

title: Irish Travellers' nomadic life 'is at risk', says support committee
